title: Calico v3.32.4
summary: Patch release for the v3.32 line: IPAM leak and duplicate-IP fixes, nftables-mode Felix configuration now honored, eBPF conntrack map autoscaling per IP family, and a new RPF drop counter.

title: Volcano v1.15.4
summary: Patch release for the v1.15 line: gang scheduling fixes for DRA-only pods, double rollback on gang eviction simulation, ancestor queue capacity accounting, and completed PodGroup quota reservation.

title: BuildKit v0.35.0
summary: Bundled Dockerfile frontend updated to 1.29.0; HTTP sources retry transient failures and honor Retry-After; registry auth refreshes rejected credentials before retrying token requests.
